L86: 
L87: Reliable access to open coding models with two usage tiers.
L88: 
L89: OpenCode Go gives you reliable access to popular open coding models, with two monthly plans:
L90: 
L91: Plan  | Price  | Included usage
L92: --- | --- | ---
L93: Go  | $10/month  | Lower-cost access to the models below
L94: Go Plus  | $40/month  | Higher usage limits across the models below
L95: 
L96: Go works like any other provider in OpenCode. You subscribe to OpenCode Go and get your API key. It’s completely optional and you don’t need to use it to use OpenCode.
L97: The service is designed primarily for international users and provides stable global access.
L98: 
L99: * * *
L100: ## cite39†Background L101: 
L102: Open models have gotten really good. They now reach performance close to proprietary models for coding tasks. And because many providers can serve them competitively, they are usually far cheaper.
L103: 
L104: However, getting reliable, low latency access to them can be difficult. Providers vary in quality and availability.
L105: 
L106: Tip
L107: 
L108: We tested a select group of models and providers that work well with OpenCode.
L109: 
L110: To fix this, we did a couple of things:
L111:   1. We tested a select group of open models and talked to their teams about how to best run them.
L112:   2. We then worked with a few providers to make sure these were being served correctly.
L113:   3. Finally, we benchmarked the combination of the model/provider and came up with a list that we feel good recommending.
L114: 
L115: Both Go and Go Plus provide access to these models; choose the plan that fits how much you use them.
L116: 
L117: * * *
L408: ### cite46†Usage beyond limits L409: 
L410: If you also have credits on your Zen balance, you can enable the Use balance option in the console. When enabled, Go will fall back to your Zen balance after you’ve reached your usage limits instead of blocking requests.

L413: ### cite47†Why some models have lower usage L414: 
L415: With Go, the included monthly usage varies by model.
L416: 
L417: For most models, we make this work through bulk discounts and reserved GPU capacity. We then pass those savings on to you as higher monthly usage.
L418: 
L419: For some models, we haven’t had the opportunity to negotiate a discount or host them at a lower cost, either because the model is new or because their public pricing is already discounted.
L420: For these models, you still get a little more than if you paid the model providers directly; this is why their included monthly usage is lower.
L421:
